## Where

docs/play-checklist.md

## Goal

One checklist of the Google Play policies Vocal Wren must meet (User Data and privacy policy, Data safety form, permissions for RECORD_AUDIO and POST_NOTIFICATIONS, health and medical claims, deceptive behaviour, target API level, store listing), each with a stable ID and a link to the current policy text, so specs can cite IDs in their Play Impact sections as CLAUDE.md requires

## Done when

Checklist merged with an ID per point; spec 001's Play Impact rows updated with IDs
seen.title: Write the Google Play policy checklist with stable IDs
